quests.desc: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! First stop, go to the west. Then, try to go north. With that over with, make an effort to move west. Following that, make an attempt to travel north. With that done, venture north. And then, move east. And then, try to take a trip south. After that, go to the east. And then, try to head south. Then, move east. And then, recover the latchkey from the bowl inside the dish-pit. And once you've done that, you win!

objective: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an profound round of TextWorld? You do! Here is your task for today. First of all, you could, like, travel west. With that accomplished, travel north. If you can succeed at that, make an effort to go to the west. After that, travel north. That done, travel north. And then, venture east. If you can succeed at that, go south. Then, move east. Once you do that, make an effort to venture south. And then, go east. Then, retrieve the latchkey from the bowl. Got that? Good!
